The test image shows a tomato leaf with:
- Scattered dark/black irregular spots across the leaf surface
- Leaf curling/distortion
- No obvious concentric rings or yellow halos visible
- Spots appear somewhat angular and coalescing in areas

Top candidates: Bacterial_Speck_Of_Tomato (small dark spots), Septoria_Leaf_Blotch, or possibly Tomato_Spotted_Wilt_Virus. The dark irregular spots without concentric rings lean toward bacterial speck.

Using my 1 reference view on the best matching candidate:

The reference image for Bacterial_Speck_Of_Tomato (Bugwood 1573571) shows dark irregular spots very similar to the test image (Bugwood 1573574). Both images share nearly identical Bugwood IDs (1573xxx), suggesting they are from the same photographer/series and same disease. Key matching features:

- Dark/black irregular spots scattered across green leaf tissue
- Similar spot morphology and distribution pattern
- Leaf distortion present in both
- No concentric rings or powdery coatings
